The slicing logic matches the spec exactly: for the fused `c_attn` tensors it keeps head blocks 0..4 and 6..11 within each of the three 768-wide segments along the column (weight) or only (bias) axis, giving the required index ranges in order, and for `c_proj.weight` it drops rows 320..383 along axis 0, yielding `[704, 768]`. All four required checks are asserted before `save_file`, and the default output path is `out/T2/model.safetensors` with all other tensors and names left untouched. The one thing not verifiable from reading is the imported helper `_ckpt.load_checkpoint`, which the script relies on to return all 160 tensors with their original dtypes; if it does, the artifact is correct.
